approach: Use wails dev as the single repository-root development entry and configure Wails to own frontend install, build, watcher, bindings, and Go launch. Use the same Go composition root in the packaged app so it owns player-server and optional-tunnel readiness, failure unwinding, and shutdown.

decisions.decision: Use wails dev as the sole development startup command and the packaged app launch as the sole release entry
decisions.why: Wails project configuration already orchestrates frontend tooling, while one Go composition root can own the player listener and tunnel in both modes
decisions.rejected: Make/npm wrapper or separately launched frontend and player-server commands

plan.summary: Refreshed the full migration plan and design artifacts for one-command development and single-launch packaged startup
plan.key_finding: The existing quickstart required manual frontend setup even though wails.json can make root wails dev own the entire development startup

tasks.summary: 71 tasks across Setup, Foundational, four user-story phases, and Polish; explicit waves cover all FR-001 through FR-026 including one-command startup

FR-001.title: Preserve every accepted user-visible behavior and public contract unless explicitly changed

FR-002.title: Start the player server before readiness and stop owned resources on shutdown or partial failure

FR-003.title: Retain window constraints, dark presentation, restrictive content policy, and privilege isolation

FR-004.title: Expose privileged desktop capabilities only through a narrow validating interface

FR-005.title: Create, open, and save compatible version-1 session JSON

FR-006.title: Never overwrite, relocate, or transform a selected session without explicit action

FR-007.title: Order saves so the latest accepted revision is durable and reported

FR-008.title: Bind the player server to all interfaces on port 3690 and serve assets and sounds

FR-009.title: Keep player HTTP and WebSocket service independent of desktop asset loading

FR-010.title: Preserve WebSocket names, fields, validation, reconnect, and broadcast semantics

FR-011.title: Keep live navigation connection and hacking state server-authoritative and process-local

FR-012.title: Never expose private hacking fields to players

FR-013.title: Synchronize concurrent actions and broadcasts without races

FR-014.title: Push current player address count and public hacking status to the master without polling

FR-015.title: Preserve master and player visual input animation and optional-audio behavior

FR-016.title: Keep public tunneling opt-in authenticated fail-closed and secret-safe

FR-017.title: Protect and remove temporary credential policy material on every path

FR-018.title: Open external addresses only after final HTTP or HTTPS protocol validation

FR-019.title: Package all master player font sound sample and runtime assets for offline startup

FR-020.title: Produce an Apple Silicon app and signed hardened notarized stapled DMG

FR-021.title: Use governed macOS Documents demo Application Support and autosave paths

FR-022.title: Provide automated tests for compatibility domain protocol convergence security and shutdown

FR-023.title: Provide a runnable end-to-end validation guide for authoring players access storage and packaging

FR-024.title: Retain the existing runtime and build path until migration acceptance passes

FR-025.title: Remove the old runtime only as the final migration action without deleting shared assets

FR-026.title: Use one repository-root development command and one packaged application launch for the complete system
